about: Issues #1182 and #1206: made-up replay cases of the triage, each a world (a chat and its messages, or Lark's chats and threads, or a meeting, with the Inbox's items) and what the triage must leave. triage.eval.mjs runs each with triage.md and a real model; the check's lines are what new-messages.mjs prints for the world after since. The real cases are kept privately in the main Bot's folder on zm (thu-ky/triage-cases.real.json; owner, 2026-11-27), in the same form. README.md, 'The replay cases', says what each expectation checks.
